subject.title: Improve context overflow error message with specifics

question: Which context-overflow facts should OpenClaw expose in user-visible channel replies versus keep in logs or session metadata?
rationale: The source already has enough model, token, budget, route, and session facts, but exposing raw channel/session identifiers or exact counts changes privacy and support behavior that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Show Redacted Diagnostics
options.body: Expose provider/model, effective limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs or metadata.

options.title: Keep Details Operator-Only
options.body: Keep chat copy generic and document status/log surfaces where operators can inspect context-pressure details.

options.title: Defer To Broader Visibility Design
options.body: Keep this issue open until a broader context visibility plan decides shared UI, logs, and channel-message behavior together.

recommendation.title: Show Redacted Diagnostics
recommendation.body: Expose provider/model, effective limit, observed or estimated token count, overage, and a redacted session/channel label while keeping raw identifiers in logs or metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue needs product-facing recovery and redaction policy ownership, and prior live review plus file history make steipete the clearest routing owner among the likely owners.
